module_summary: Instruction register with two 8-bit holding registers loaded from data selected by fetch code, outputs slice ins_p1 into opcode/address fields and expose ins_p2.

anchors.name: ins_p1
anchors.why: Holds instruction from register source (fetch=01); split into ins opcode and ad1 address.

anchors.name: ins_p2
anchors.why: Holds second instruction byte from RAM/ROM (fetch=10); drives ad2 directly.

anchors.name: fetch
anchors.why: 2-bit fetch code selecting which holding register loads data.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: 8-bit instruction input loaded into ins_p1 or ins_p2.

anchors.name: ins
anchors.why: Opcode field, top 3 bits of ins_p1.

anchors.name: ad1
anchors.why: Register address field, low 5 bits of ins_p1.

groups.name: instruction_registers
groups.description: Two fetch-selected 8-bit instruction holding registers loaded from data.

groups.name: field_split
groups.description: Splits ins_p1 into opcode and register-address fields; ad2 copies ins_p2.
